name: basic-feature-changelog
description: Generate changelog from commits with simple feat and fix types

steps.content:
Generate a changelog for the last 5 commits. The git log contains:
- feat(auth): add login with Google (#42)
- fix(ui): button alignment on mobile (#38)
- chore: update dependencies
- feat(api): add pagination to /users endpoint (#45)
- test: add unit tests for auth module

name: breaking-change-detection
description: Correctly identify and categorize breaking changes

steps.content:
Generate a changelog. The git log contains:
- feat!: remove v1 API endpoints (#50)
- feat(auth): add refresh token support (#51)
- fix(db): connection pool leak

The first commit body contains: BREAKING CHANGE: All /api/v1/* endpoints are removed. Migrate to /api/v2/*.

name: no-meaningful-commits
description: Handle case where all commits are chore/ci/test

steps.content:
